title: Trump's Strategic Diplomacy: Strengthening US-China Ties
description: After returning from China, US President Donald Trump touted significant trade agreements and strengthened relations with President Xi Jinping. Highlighting the sale of Boeing aircraft, Trump's diplomacy aimed to elevate US-China relations, fostering mutual respect and understanding, while addressing concerns over Taiwan's independence.

title: Trump, on Taiwan: “They stole our chip industry.”
description:

title: Strait of Hormuz was open for navigation until Feb 28 when Iran faced aggression, says Lavrov
description: NEW DELHI, May 15: The Strait of Hormuz was open for safe navigation until February 28 when the US and Israel launched an aggression against Iran, Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said here on Friday. Interacting with reporters here, he made the comments in Russian, which were translated into English by an interpreter. The minister was asked about the choking of the Strait of Hormuz, and reports suggesting attempts by the US to get China to do something to help […]

title: Trump says patience with Iran is running out, insists he didn't ask China for favors
description: Donald Trump said Xi Jinping agreed that Iran must reopen the Strait of Hormuz after talks in Beijing. The remarks left open whether China will press Tehran, while oil markets and nuclear negotiations remain under strain.
